theorem PaperCV3Audit.CriticalField.exact_source_coefficients (N L : Nat) (omega : PaperCV3Audit.InfiniteSample)
  (j : PaperCV3Audit.CriticalField.SpatialIndex N) :
  Eq (DFunLike.coe (PaperCV3Audit.CriticalField.spatialSource N L omega) j)
    (ite
      (And
        (PaperCV3Audit.ExactLengthEvent (PaperCV3Audit.infiniteValueBit omega) (HAdd.hAdd N ↑(Prod.fst j))
          (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd L (Prod.fst (Prod.snd j))) 1))
        (Eq (PaperCV3Audit.infiniteValueBit omega (HAdd.hAdd N ↑(Prod.fst j))) (Prod.snd (Prod.snd j))))
      1 0)

theorem PaperCV3Audit.CriticalField.spatial_hard_conditioning (hAGG : PaperCV3Audit.Process.ProcessAGGStatement)
  (hPNT : PaperCV3Audit.Analysis.PrimeNumberTheoremRemainder) (lo hi K c : Real) (hlo : LT.lt 0 lo) (hhi : LT.lt lo hi)
  (hc : LT.lt 0 c) :
  Exists fun Nzero =>
    ∀ (N : Nat),
      GE.ge N Nzero →
        ∀ (L : Nat),
          LE.le (HMul.hMul lo (Real.log ↑N)) (HAdd.hAdd (↑L) 1) →
            LE.le (HAdd.hAdd (↑L) 1) (HMul.hMul hi (Real.log ↑N)) →
              LE.le (NNReal.toReal (PaperCV3Audit.fullRate N L)) K →
                ∀ (A : Set PaperCV3Audit.InfiniteSample),
                  MeasurableSet A →
                    LT.lt 0 (MeasureTheory.Measure.real PaperCV3Audit.infiniteRademacherMeasure A) →
                      LE.le (PaperCV3Audit.CriticalField.eventInformation A)
                          (HSub.hSub (PaperCV3Audit.Analysis.saddleCutoff 1 (Real.log ↑N))
                            (HMul.hMul c (PaperCV3Audit.Analysis.saddleNu 1 (Real.log ↑N)))) →
                        LE.le (PaperCV3Audit.CriticalField.spatialEventDistance N L A)
                          (HAdd.hAdd
                            (HAdd.hAdd
                              (HMul.hMul 32
                                (Real.exp
                                  (HMul.hMul (Neg.neg (HDiv.hDiv c 4))
                                    (PaperCV3Audit.Analysis.saddleNu 1 (Real.log ↑N)))))
                              (HMul.hMul 32 (HPow.hPow (↑N) (Neg.neg (1 / 12)))))
                            (HMul.hMul 3 (Real.exp (Neg.neg (PaperCV3Audit.Analysis.saddleCutoff 1 (Real.log ↑N))))))
name: PaperCV3Audit.CriticalField.spatial_hard_conditioning

  (hc : LT.lt 0 c) :

declaration:
theorem PaperCV3Audit.CriticalField.uniform_quenched_scalar (hStein : PaperCV3Audit.Analysis.ScalarSteinFactorsStatement)
  (hPNT : PaperCV3Audit.Analysis.PrimeNumberTheoremRemainder) (sizes : Nat → Nat)
  (hg :
    Exists fun A =>
      And (LT.lt 0 A) (Filter.Eventually (fun k => LE.le (↑k) (HMul.hMul A (Real.log ↑(sizes k)))) Filter.atTop))
  (lo hi c beta : Real) (hlo : LT.lt 0 lo) (hhi : LT.lt lo hi) (hb : LT.lt 0 beta) (hbc : LT.lt beta c) :
  Filter.Eventually
    (fun omega =>
      Filter.Eventually
        (fun k =>
          ∀ (L : Nat),
            LE.le (HMul.hMul lo (Real.log ↑(sizes k))) (HAdd.hAdd (↑L) 1) →
              LE.le (HAdd.hAdd (↑L) 1) (HMul.hMul hi (Real.log ↑(sizes k))) →
                LE.le (Max.max 0 (Real.log (NNReal.toReal (PaperCV3Audit.fullRate (sizes k) L))))
                    (HSub.hSub (PaperCV3Audit.Analysis.saddleCutoff 1 (Real.log ↑(sizes k)))
                      (HMul.hMul c (PaperCV3Audit.Analysis.saddleNu 1 (Real.log ↑(sizes k))))) →
                  LE.le
                    (PaperCV3Audit.environmentDistance (PaperCV3Audit.Analysis.hardCutoff (sizes k))
                      (PaperCV3Audit.maskedCount L (PaperCV3Audit.dyadicBlock (sizes k)))
                      (PaperCV3Audit.Analysis.poissonMass (PaperCV3Audit.fullRate (sizes k) L)) omega)
                    (Real.exp (HMul.hMul (Neg.neg beta) (PaperCV3Audit.Analysis.saddleNu 1 (Real.log ↑(sizes k))))))
        Filter.atTop)
    (MeasureTheory.ae PaperCV3Audit.infiniteRademacherMeasure)
name: PaperCV3Audit.CriticalField.uniform_quenched_scalar

declaration:
theorem PaperCV3Audit.CriticalField.critical_diffuse (hAGG : PaperCV3Audit.Process.ProcessAGGStatement)
  (hPNT : PaperCV3Audit.Analysis.PrimeNumberTheoremRemainder) (C : Real) (hC : LE.le 0 C) (sizes lengths : Nat → Nat)
  (rate : NNReal) (hsizes : Filter.Tendsto sizes Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
  (hwindow :
    Filter.Eventually (fun j => PaperCV3Audit.CriticalField.criticalWindow C (sizes j) (lengths j)) Filter.atTop)
  (hrate :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun j => NNReal.toReal (PaperCV3Audit.fullRate (sizes j) (lengths j))) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (NNReal.toReal rate))) :
  Exists fun laws =>
    Exists fun target =>
      And
        (∀ (j : Nat),
          Eq (MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure.toMeasure (laws j))
            (MeasureTheory.Measure.map
              (Function.comp (PaperCV3Audit.CriticalField.spatialEmbedding (sizes j))
                (PaperCV3Audit.CriticalField.spatialSource (sizes j) (lengths j)))
              PaperCV3Audit.infiniteRademacherMeasure))
        (And (Eq (MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure.toMeasure target) (PaperCV3Audit.CriticalField.diffuseMeasure rate))
          (Filter.Tendsto laws Filter.atTop (nhds target)))
name: PaperCV3Audit.CriticalField.critical_diffuse

declaration:
theorem PaperCV3Audit.CriticalField.stable_small_prime_record.{u_1, u_2} {β : Type u_1} {γ : Type u_2} [MeasurableSpace β]
  [StandardBorelSpace β] [Nonempty β] [Countable β] [MeasurableSingletonClass β] [MeasurableSpace γ] (Y : Nat)
  (f : PaperCV3Audit.InfiniteSample → β) (hf : Measurable f) (nu : MeasureTheory.Measure β)
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure nu] (V : PaperCV3Audit.InfiniteSample → γ) (hV : Measurable V)
  (D : Set PaperCV3Audit.InfiniteSample) (hD : MeasurableSet D)
  (hpos : LT.lt 0 (MeasureTheory.Measure.real PaperCV3Audit.infiniteRademacherMeasure D)) :
  And
    (LE.le
      (PaperCV3Audit.CriticalField.measureTV
        (MeasureTheory.Measure.map f (ProbabilityTheory.cond PaperCV3Audit.infiniteRademacherMeasure D)) nu)
      (HDiv.hDiv
        (MeasureTheory.integral PaperCV3Audit.infiniteRademacherMeasure fun omega =>
          PaperCV3Audit.environmentDistance Y f (PaperCV3Audit.observableLaw nu id) omega)
        (MeasureTheory.Measure.real PaperCV3Audit.infiniteRademacherMeasure D)))
    (LE.le
      (PaperCV3Audit.CriticalField.measureTV
        (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun omega => Prod.mk (V omega) (f omega))
          (ProbabilityTheory.cond PaperCV3Audit.infiniteRademacherMeasure D))
        (MeasureTheory.Measure.prod
          (MeasureTheory.Measure.map V (ProbabilityTheory.cond PaperCV3Audit.infiniteRademacherMeasure D)) nu))
      (HDiv.hDiv
        (MeasureTheory.integral PaperCV3Audit.infiniteRademacherMeasure fun omega =>
          PaperCV3Audit.environmentDistance Y f (PaperCV3Audit.observableLaw nu id) omega)
        (MeasureTheory.Measure.real PaperCV3Audit.infiniteRademacherMeasure D)))
name: PaperCV3Audit.CriticalField.stable_small_prime_record

declaration:
theorem PaperCV3Audit.CriticalField.spatial_conditional_mean (hAGG : PaperCV3Audit.Process.ProcessAGGStatement)
  (hPNT : PaperCV3Audit.Analysis.PrimeNumberTheoremRemainder) (lo hi c c' : Real) (hlo : LT.lt 0 lo) (hhi : LT.lt lo hi)
  (hc' : LT.lt 0 c') (hcc : LT.lt c' c) :
  Exists fun Nzero =>
    ∀ (N : Nat),
      GE.ge N Nzero →
        ∀ (L : Nat),
          LE.le (HMul.hMul lo (Real.log ↑N)) (HAdd.hAdd (↑L) 1) →
            LE.le (HAdd.hAdd (↑L) 1) (HMul.hMul hi (Real.log ↑N)) →
              LE.le 1 (NNReal.toReal (PaperCV3Audit.fullRate N L)) →
                LE.le
                    (HAdd.hAdd (Real.log (NNReal.toReal (PaperCV3Audit.fullRate N L)))
                      (Real.log (HAdd.hAdd 1 (NNReal.toReal (PaperCV3Audit.fullRate N L)))))
                    (HSub.hSub (PaperCV3Audit.Analysis.saddleCutoff 1 (Real.log ↑N))
                      (HMul.hMul c (PaperCV3Audit.Analysis.saddleNu 1 (Real.log ↑N)))) →
                  LE.le (PaperCV3Audit.CriticalField.spatialMeanDistance N L (PaperCV3Audit.Analysis.hardCutoff N))
                    (HMul.hMul 67 (Real.exp (HMul.hMul (Neg.neg c') (PaperCV3Audit.Analysis.saddleNu 1 (Real.log ↑N)))))
name: PaperCV3Audit.CriticalField.spatial_conditional_mean
